audience: schools that run Veracross and want an AI assistant to read their student, class and grade records

useCases.title: Look up the students in a grade and their homerooms
useCases.text: List students with grade level, homeroom, household and enrollment status, one page at a time. Read one student record by person id for the full details.

useCases.title: See which classes a student takes and who teaches them
useCases.text: List the enrollments to see each student's status in a class and any withdrawal date. Then list the classes for course, teacher, room and school year.

useCases.title: Review the numeric grades posted for a class
useCases.text: List numeric grades per enrollment and grading period, with the posted grade, letter grade, lock status and comment.

useCases.title: Track assignments and student completion for a class
useCases.text: List the assignments of one class with assigned and due dates, type, max score and weight. Then list each student's completion status and raw score on them.

useCases.title: Review daily attendance for students and faculty
useCases.text: List the daily attendance records per person. Each record shows the status, whether it is excused, and any late arrival or early dismissal.

useCases.title: Build a contact list for each household
useCases.text: List parents and guardians linked to households. Then read each household's family name and mailing address, and the email and phone numbers of each person.
